raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Allow `QuantizedDBuffer.allgather` to accept multiple mesh axes and forward them to every data/scale plane. Materialize an axis iterator once so all four planes receive the same axes. Existing output-buffer reuse is preserved.

Use separate 1D and 2D plane-gather tests covering allocating and preallocated output. The 2D test passes a one-shot axis iterator and checks every byte in all four planes without invoking MXFP8 arithmetic. Restrict the MXFP8 hardware skip to quantization and GEMM tests so byte-plane tests run on older GPUs too.

The DBuffer support from #7633 is now merged in `main`. This PR contains only the quantized wrapper and its tests; it is independent of the MCore adapter change (#7728).

## Validation

- Rebased onto `36731acc3`, preserving main's expanded scale-padding test and all five PR commits. The only conflict resolution adds the MXFP8 skip decorator to that expanded test.
- Ran the complete `test_quantized_dbuffer.py` file through `torch.distributed.run` on two RTX A6000 GPUs: 6 passed and 7 skipped per rank. This covers redistribution, shared-storage views, and 1D/2D all-gathers with allocating and preallocated output; the 2D mesh was `(2, 1)`. Seven quantization/GEMM cases require MXFP8-capable hardware and were skipped.
- `tools/autoformat.sh` check mode completed successfully: Black, isort, and Ruff passed; Pylint rated the code 10/10 with its unsupported `bad-builtins` configuration diagnostic. Advisory mypy reported six missing Transformer Engine module/stub diagnostics. `git diff --check` passed.

## Contribution process

- [x] Updated the existing plane-gather test.
- [x] Updated the all-gather type annotation.
- [x] Ran the repository autoformatter in check mode (limitations above).

Removing the parameterization is a coverage regression.
The rewrite always passes out=. but in`quantized_dbuffer.py:300-301` the "no `out`" allocates fresh planes and builds a new wrapper via _from_planes(...), so a different code path.

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_out", [False, True])
...
result = source.allgather((0, 1), out=out if use_out else None)
if use_out:
    assert result is out
```
should fix the regression
The tests pass regardless of the code changes, so they don't enforce any new behavior

@@ -25,10 +25,12 @@
 
 pytestmark = pytest.mark.launch_on_gb200
 
-if not is_mxfp8_available():
-    pytest.skip("MXFP8 quantization is not available.", allow_module_level=True)
+requires_mxfp8 = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not is_mxfp8_available(), reason="MXFP8 quantization is not available."
+)
 
 
+@requires_mxfp8
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
     "placements",
     [
@@ -99,6 +101,7 @@ def test_quantized_dbuffer_quantization_matches_te(distributed_setup, placements
     assert all(plane.local_buffer.eq(canary).all() for plane in replicated.planes)
 
 
+@requires_mxfp8
 def test_quantized_dbuffer_get_tensor_supports_gemm(distributed_setup):
     """Compute tensors prepare gathered scales for rowwise and columnwise GEMMs."""
     device = distributed_setup.device
@@ -198,3 +201,35 @@ def test_quantized_dbuffer_allgathers_every_plane(distributed_setup, use_out):
         chunks = plane.local_buffer.view(mesh.size(), -1)
         for rank in range(mesh.size()):
             assert chunks[rank].eq(index * mesh.size() + rank).all()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_out", [False, True])
+def test_quantized_dbuffer_allgathers_every_plane_on_2d_mesh(distributed_setup, use_out):
+    """Gather an axis iterator in every plane, allocating or reusing output."""
+    world_size = distributed_setup.world_size
+    if world_size < 2 or world_size % 2:
+        pytest.skip("Requires an even world size of at least two.")
+    mesh = init_device_mesh(distributed_setup.device.type, (2, world_size // 2))
+    source = QuantizedDBuffer.empty(
+        mesh, [BlockAtomic(32), BlockAtomic(32)], [(128, 64), (32, 128)], distributed_setup.device
+    )
+    for index, plane in enumerate(source.planes):
+        values = (
+            torch.arange(plane.local_buffer.numel(), device=plane.device) + plane.offset + index
+        )
+        plane.local_buffer.copy_(values % 251)
+    # A one-shot iterator must be reusable across all four planes.
+    if use_out:
+        out = QuantizedDBuffer.empty(
+            mesh, [Replicate(), Replicate()], [(128, 64), (32, 128)], distributed_setup.device
+        )
+        result = source.allgather(iter((0, 1)), out=out)
+        assert result is out
+    else:
+        out = source.allgather(iter((0, 1)))
+    for index, plane in enumerate(out.planes):
+        assert plane.placements == (Replicate(), Replicate())
+        expected = (
+            (torch.arange(plane.local_buffer.numel(), device=plane.device) + index) % 251
+        ).to(plane.dtype)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(plane.local_buffer, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
